explanation: The war put the men and the island where they were: the rising was “an insurrection by the 882nd Infantry Battalion Königin Tamara of the Georgian Legion of the German Army stationed on the German-occupied Dutch island of Texel”, and the article calls it “one of the last battles in the European theatre”. A battle inside a war is caused by it in the sense this atlas uses, and it is filed inside the war as well.
